notes: The 'how' of 'how thou wentest' is the one added unit; the Hebrew has a bare infinitive construct with suffix and no conjunction and no preposition, so rule 52 has no preposition to place the complementizer on and rule 55 governs.

s031 זְרוּעָה is an articleless attributive recast as a relative clause, so the supplied relative and copula stay with the attributive under rule 41's closing paragraph, while the negative לֹא keeps its own word.
